name: Vulcan Memory
description: Connects OpenClaw memory hooks and tools to Vulcan Memory Mesh through vulcan-host.

protoPath.description: Optional override for the bundled mcp_service.proto; a compatible vmm.proto must be in the same directory.

enabled.description: Whether Vulcan memory tools and hooks are enabled.

autoRecall.description: Whether before_prompt_build should inject VMM recall context.

autoPostAction.description: Whether agent_end should write a clipped turn summary to VMM through vulcan-host. Default false.

recallTopK.description: Maximum VMM recall hits per automatic query.
